input.question: This trigger needs to be held to drop a pill, card, rune, or trinket. In your other games you're evenly split between doing this kind of held action with a mouth action and by pushing the joystick forward. Which do you want here?

input.summary: All 31 controls settled or asked. Movement, shooting, bombs, pocket-item use, map, and pause all bound from strongly lopsided habit evidence across both keyboard and gamepad equivalents (evidenced). Two genuinely split jobs were sent to the user: pocket-item use (kb_q) and drop-item hold (kb_left_control) on keyboard, plus the drop-item hold on the right trigger, which showed its own even split between a mouth action and a joystick push. The 13 controls with no documented function in this game (A, B, X, Y, kb_f, dpad_N, dpad_S, kb_c, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_shift, kb_x, mouse_right_button) were left unbound rather than given an invented purpose.
